summary: It's yet another spooky patch, run! Structured changes across 17 entities this patch.

champions.name: Aatrox
champions.tldr: Heal reduced to 80% of post-mitigation damage from 100%.
champions.gameplayImpact: Aatrox loses power in the listed areas. Mains should adjust builds/play patterns; counters get an easier time.

lines.label: Heal
lines.note: Heal reduced to 80% of post-mitigation damage from 100%.

champions.name: Akshan
champions.tldr: New Effect: Swing duration is now indefinite, rather than ending after 3 seconds.
champions.gameplayImpact: Akshan is stronger on paper. Expect a higher presence until the meta adapts; good time to learn or re-pick them.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Effect: Swing duration is now indefinite, rather than ending after 3 seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Fixed some bugs that would cause him to spin in place when using the ability in certain locations.

champions.name: Blitzcrank
champions.tldr: Shield strength changed to 15–45% maximum mana from 30%|mana at all levels.; Base damage reduced to 105–285 from 105–305.
champions.gameplayImpact: Blitzcrank was adjusted in mixed directions. Net power depends on playstyle — read the numbers before assuming a free buff or hard nerf.
